properties.description: reasoning.rs: reasoning_report lists an assumption a step discharges (and that is no ordinary premise anywhere) under `assumptions` only, never `unsupported`; a claim that holds only under an undischarged assumption reads `truth: conditional`, naming it. heal.rs + inference.rs: in a line of reasoning (a step's premise or conclusion, or a statement with statement_kind or taken_as_given), an opposing CONTRADICTS whose objection is answered, or that stands undecided (a lone objection, a mutual attack, an odd cycle) and states its reason in evidence, is counted under swept.suppressed_as_objection and never reported by detect_defects or counted by loop_status; one that refutes stays under suppressed_by_refutation. A CONTRADICTS outside any line of reasoning, or a standing one that states no reason, is still reported.
properties.name: A correct proof reads correct: discharged assumptions are not unsupported, settled or argued objections are not defects, conditional claims read conditional
